title: fix(cloud-connection)!: install-local parses manifest.namespace through its declaration
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbTGhxJSYAmQXU7efVdNqrpw)_
Fixes #33922

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none (the declaration `ManifestSchema.shape.namespace` already refuses these values; this door now enforces it. The dev confirms against the diff.)
Skills-docs: follow-up #34370 (`content/docs/deployment/publish-and-preview.mdx` names the namespace refusal beside the id; L1 6909138595 N1)

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:本地安装入口 `POST /api/v1/marketplace/install-local` 现在按清单声明校验 `namespace`,与它已经校验 `id` 的方式一致。
- 为什么改:`''`、`QA_N`、`9-Bad Ns!` 这类作者根本写不出来的命名空间能装进来,`QA_N` 还能绕过 `qa_n` 已有主人的命名空间唯一性检查。
- 风险与回滚:只收紧这一扇门;不写 `namespace` 的包照常安装,已装的旧包照常加载和卸载。回滚即撤销本 PR 一个提交区间。
- 先看:`packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts` 中 `namespaceRefusal` 与步骤 1b″;再看新测试 `marketplace-install-local-namespace-gate-33922.test.ts`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/cloud-connection exec vitest run src/marketplace-install-local-namespace-gate-33922.test.ts`,预期 15 条全绿。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- The install-local door parses the package's `namespace` through its declaration, `ManifestSchema.shape.namespace` (`NAMESPACE_PATTERN`), by reference, right after the id gate and at the same converged point of the inline and cloud branches. It reads the top-level `manifest.namespace` of the body this door hands `manifest.register` (after `normalizeBundle` flattens a compiled bundle), which is the key registration reads: `registerApp` installs the package under that key of that same body. It does not read through the nested-manifest helper `declaredPackageManifest`, because on a body that still carries a nested `manifest` after the flatten, that helper answers about a namespace nothing installs under.
- A refused value answers `PLUGIN_MANIFEST_INVALID` with the id gate's status split: `400` for a caller's inline manifest, `502` for an upstream snapshot (the grant path's inline manifest included). Nothing is registered, synced or ledgered. The message uses the frame the door already uses for an invalid `installModes`, with the declaration's own sentence inside it: ``Package 'ID' declares an invalid `namespace`: SENTENCE.`` No code and no wording is minted.
- An absent `namespace` is admitted, because the declaration makes the key optional.
- Rehydrate and the `:manifestId` routes are not gated, for the id gate's reason. An entry an older build ledgered under such a namespace still loads at boot and can still be removed.
- BREAKING (patch, `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`): the changeset carries the FROM/TO lines and the ADR-0087 disposition `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`.

## Tests

New file `packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-namespace-gate-33922.test.ts`, 15 cases:

- `''`, `'QA_N'`, `'9-Bad Ns!'` and a non-string value, on a flat inline manifest: `400` in the declared ADR-0112 envelope (`BaseResponseSchema`, `envelopeViolations`, `ApiErrorSchema`), code `PLUGIN_MANIFEST_INVALID`. The message contains the declaration's sentence, read from the schema at test time and never copied. No `manifest.register`, no `syncSchemas`, no ledger file.
- A compiled bundle whose nested `manifest.namespace` is `QA_N`: the same `400`.
- A cloud snapshot declaring `QA_N`: `502`, after exactly one fetch.
- The body registration reads: a body that still carries a nested `manifest` after the flatten, with a conforming nested `namespace` (`qa_ok`) and `QA_N` at its top level. It gets the `400` inline and the `502` from a snapshot (after exactly one fetch), with nothing written, and over the real engine below the registry holds nothing under `QA_N`. These three cases are red when the gate reads through the nested-manifest helper instead (the ablation below).
- Lit controls: a conforming namespace installs, an absent one installs, and a conforming multi-package artifact installs.
- UNMOVED: an artifact member declaring `QA_N` keeps the artifact-entry parse's refusal (`INVALID_ARTIFACT_PACKAGE_ENTRY`, 422), and nothing is written.
- Over a real `ObjectKernel` + `ObjectQLPlugin`, with `com.qa.n-one` owning `qa_n`: `QA_N` gets the `400`. The registry does not hold it, `getNamespaceOwners('qa_n')` is still the owner alone, and the ledger holds only the owner. CONTROL: `qa_n` beside that owner still gets the registry's own namespace refusal (`422 PLUGIN_REGISTER_FAILED`, naming the owner). The gate's comparison needed no change.

## Acceptance notes

- PM hypothesis 1 held in part. The id leg's code and status split are reused, but its message is not: the id leg's sentence (`manifestIdRefusal`) names the key and the value, while the namespace declaration's sentence names neither. So the refusal uses the door's existing `installModes` frame around the declaration's sentence.
- Hypothesis 2 held: `namespace` is `.optional()` in `ManifestSchema`, and absence installs (pinned).
- Hypothesis 3: every install-local install (HTTP POST and the grant door's `installForGrant`) goes through `handleInstall`, so one leg covers them all. The members of a multi-package artifact were measured to be already judged: each `packages[]` entry is parsed whole through `ArtifactPackageSchema` (the core's `resolveArtifactPackageOrder`, reached through `unrunnableCode` before any write), and it throws `INVALID_ARTIFACT_PACKAGE_ENTRY` / 422 for the same namespace. A first draft of this PR added a second judge for members, and the ablation showed that it moved an existing answer without closing any gap, so it was removed. The member case is pinned as unmoved.
- Hypothesis 4 held: the registry gate's comparison is unchanged (the CONTROL case above).
- Not in this diff: `POST /api/v1/packages` (`packages/runtime`) is another door and outside the claim's surface. Nothing was measured or changed there.
